Response that includes tool call output items

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val request = mapper.readValue("{\"input\":\"What is the weather in San Francisco?\",\"model\":\"gpt-4o\",\"tools\":[{\"description\":\"Get current weather for a location\",\"name\":\"get_weather\",\"parameters\":{\"properties\":{\"location\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"location\"],\"type\":\"object\"},\"type\":\"function\"}]}", CreateResponseRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.createResponse(request)
    println(result)
}
```
